name: Bengaluru Satellite Town Ring Road

timeline.event: Construction begins on the Karnataka sections
Prime Minister inaugurates the first 80 km, from Dobbaspet to Hoskote, in March

history: The Satellite Town Ring Road is a large ring being built well outside Bengaluru, connecting the towns that circle the city — places like Doddaballapur, Devanahalli, Hoskote, Kanakapura and Ramanagara — without going anywhere near the crowded city centre. A part of the ring dips into Tamil Nadu near Hosur. The first 80 km, from Dobbaspet to Hoskote, opened in March 2024, and the remaining sections are being built in stages.
facts: A ring of about 288 km around Bengaluru, running well outside the city.
Carries the national highway number NH 948A.
The 80 km Dobbaspet–Hoskote stretch was inaugurated in March 2024.
Links about a dozen satellite towns, including Hosur across the border in Tamil Nadu.
Being built by NHAI under the Bharatmala highway programme.

sources.title: NHAI — National Highways Authority of India
